headline: President Clinton changed the wording of an earlier executive order, Executive Order 12864.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 12864, which President Clinton signed in 1993. That earlier order is generally known for setting up an advisory council on the nation's developing information networks, sometimes called the "information superhighway." No summary was provided, so the exact changes this order made are not described here.
when_it_takes_effect: Likely upon signing on June 13, 1994, though the source does not say.
